title: 3dExtrema
description: Find local extrema (minima or maxima) in 3D datasets.

output_prefix.description: Prefix for the output dataset name.
output_prefix.title: Output Prefix

output_session.description: Directory for the output dataset session.
output_session.title: Output Session Directory

mask_threshold.description: Only voxels whose mask statistic is >= m in absolute value will be considered.
mask_threshold.title: Mask Threshold

data_threshold.description: Only voxels whose value (intensity) is greater than d in absolute value will be considered.
data_threshold.title: Data Threshold

n_best.description: Only print the first N extrema.
n_best.title: Number of Extrema

separation_distance.description: Minimum separation distance (in mm) for distinct extrema.
separation_distance.title: Separation Distance

volume.description: Consider the volume as a whole.
volume.title: Volume Flag

remove.description: Remove all but strongest of neighboring extrema (default).
remove.title: Remove Flag

weight.description: Replace neighboring extrema by weighted average.
weight.title: Weighted Average Flag
